name: interstellar-wire-protocol

crc.name: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE
crc.covers: version through last payload byte (frame bytes 2 .. 12+N-1); magic and CRC excluded

plan_rules: departure_fuel_g + capture_fuel_g <= initial_fuel_g (compare in more than 32 bits)
plan_crc16 = CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE over exactly the 28 LOAD_PLAN payload bytes

sequencing.read_only: DISCOVER and GET_STATUS carry sequence 0 and any session (0 allowed). They never touch mutation sequencing. The STATUS reply header carries the board's active session (0 after reset) and the board's own wrapping telemetry sequence.
sequencing.open_session: Header session 0, sequence 0, payload = new nonzero session id. Allowed only in IDLE. Clears the replay cache; the next mutation uses sequence 1. An identical repeat while IDLE with that session already active returns APPLIED without resetting history.
sequencing.mutations: Header session must equal the active nonzero session. Stop-and-wait. Sequence starts at 1 and increases by 1 up to 65535; open a fresh IDLE session before wrap. Exact retry (same sequence, identical frame bytes) returns the cached ACK without re-applying. Same sequence with different bytes: SEQ_CONFLICT. Lower sequence: STALE_SEQ.
validation_order: frame integrity, known type, exact payload length (else discard and count, no reply)
sequencing.sequence_consumption: After shape, session and sequence checks pass, both APPLIED and REJECTED results consume and cache that sequence. Integrity, shape, session, conflict and stale failures do not advance it.
sequencing.ack_header: Echoes the request sequence; session field is the board's actual active session (so BAD_SESSION reveals the real one, and OPEN_SESSION returns the new one).

ack_semantics.COMMIT_PLAN: APPLIED = plan active, state LOADED, tick 0, mask 0
ack_semantics.START: ARMED -> RUNNING, tick divider and counter reset
ack_semantics.CLEAR: any non-RUNNING state with a mission -> IDLE, plan invalidated
ack_semantics.applied_tick: board tick when the command was applied (0 before START)
ack_semantics.mission_id: echoes the mission_id from the request payload (0 for OPEN_SESSION)
ack_semantics.plan_crc16: after LOAD_PLAN: CRC of the staged plan; otherwise CRC of the active plan; 0 if there is none
ack_semantics.unknown_type_with_valid_crc: discarded and counted in rx_error_count, no reply. Detail UNSUPPORTED (9) is reserved for a known type the build does not implement.
